guide.summary: Temples, Kraton museums and performances, with breakfast spots, bakeries, dinners and cocktail bars checked against their own websites.
guide.tip: Save Monday for Borobudur, Prambanan or Taman Sari, because the Kraton's Kedhaton and Wahanarata, Museum Ullen Sentalu, Museum Sonobudoyo and Museum Benteng Vredeburg all list Monday as closed.

toolkit.label: Closing days
toolkit.copy: The Kraton's Kedhaton and Wahanarata, Museum Ullen Sentalu, Museum Sonobudoyo and Museum Benteng Vredeburg all list Monday as closed. Taman Sari's page lists 09:00 to 15:00 every day, and InJourney's ticket page lists Borobudur as open every day.

toolkit.label: Tickets and booking
toolkit.copy: InJourney's ticket site limits Borobudur's Sunrise and Sunset sessions to 100 people per day each, and its upper-area ticket includes upanat temple sandals and a tour guide. Gembira Loka Zoo's online tickets are booked for a set date and cannot be refunded or rescheduled.

toolkit.label: Walk-in and queues
toolkit.copy: InJourney's Borobudur page advises arriving 30 to 45 minutes early and warns that late arrivals may get limited access depending on crowds. The Kraton's Kedhaton and Taman Sari pages ask you to arrive about an hour early.

toolkit.label: Rules
toolkit.copy: The Kedhaton, Taman Sari and Wahanarata ask for modest clothes with sleeves and do not allow skirts or shorts. At Pentas Srimanganti, eating, drinking, smoking and flash photography are not allowed.

guide.dek: Book the temples online, keep Mondays for the sites that stay open, and pack sleeves and long trousers for the Kraton.
intro: Yogyakarta's big temple sites sit outside the city, and their tickets are sold on InJourney Destination Management's own site. Its Borobudur page lists the temple structure every day from 08.30 to 17.00 WIB, says the upper-area ticket includes a wristband, upanat temple sandals and a tour guide, and advises you to arrive 30 to 45 minutes early. Sunrise and Sunset sessions are each limited to 100 people per day. The Prambanan ticket covers Prambanan, Lumbung, Bubrah and Sewu temples and the Prambanan Museum, while Ratu Boko Palace, on a hilltop just south of Prambanan, starts entry at 07.00 WIB.

In November and December 2026, InJourney lists the Ramayana Ballet at Prambanan's Open Air Theater on Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday from 7:30pm to 9:00pm, with Roro Jonggrang on Fridays, and no VIP tickets for those two months. If rain falls after the Anoman Obong scene, the show counts as complete and is not refunded. For a slower base near Borobudur, Amanjiwo offers a Sunrise Meditation at Borobudur experience alongside The Restaurant & Bar, and Plataran Borobudur's Patio Colonial Hall offers colonial-style dining with views of Borobudur.

In the city, the Kraton's Kagungan Dalem Kedhaton opens Tuesday to Sunday from 08:30 to 14:30 and closes on Mondays; you will need clothes with sleeves, and skirts and shorts are not allowed. The Kraton's Smarabawana exhibition, open since 7 March 2026, is set to run until January 2027. Taman Sari's page lists 09:00 to 15:00 every day, and Pentas Srimanganti performances run from 09:00 to 11:00 every day except Monday, from wayang kulit on Thursdays to Gladhen Beksan on Sundays. Museum Benteng Vredeburg stays open until 20.00 Tuesday to Thursday and 21.00 Friday to Sunday.

North of the city, Museum Ullen Sentalu runs 45-minute guided tours Tuesday to Sunday, with the last tour at 15.15, and groups reserve by phone. Museum Sonobudoyo, also closed on Mondays, charges foreign visitors Rp 20.000. For food, ViaVia Jogja on Jalan Prawirotaman opens daily at 8 am, and ViaVia Artisan Bakery at No. 32 opens at 7 am. Bakpia Pathok 25's Pabrik Jaya shop lists 06.00 to 23.30 every day. Royal Ambarrukmo's Lobby Lounge & Bar serves signature cocktails from 3 pm to 11 pm, with live piano Monday to Saturday.
summaryCards: Book Borobudur and Prambanan on InJourney's ticket site, then spend a Tuesday-to-Sunday morning at the Kraton's Kedhaton, which opens at 08:30.
Have breakfast at Kayumanis Coffee Shop, served from 6:00 to 10:00 am, or at ViaVia Artisan Bakery from 7 am, then visit Taman Sari, open 09:00 to 15:00 every day.

The Kraton's Kedhaton and Wahanarata, Museum Ullen Sentalu, Museum Sonobudoyo and Museum Benteng Vredeburg all list Monday as closed, and Borobudur's Sunrise and Sunset sessions are capped at 100 people per day.

limitations: Website review, not a visit or telephone confirmation. Advertised opening, booking and exhibition details do not guarantee availability. InJourney's Borobudur, Prambanan and Ratu Boko ticket pages carry a 2025 footer and give start times but not closing times for Prambanan and Ratu Boko; their locations come from the operator's own map pins rather than street addresses. Museum Sonobudoyo's hours are labelled January 2026 and read 'Tuesday & Sunday', so check the full weekly schedule. ViaVia Jogja's page gives two different sets of hours. Hours were not published for Taman Pintar (shown only as an image), Gudeg Yu Djum Pusat, Eboni Bar & Lounge, Amanjiwo, Plataran Borobudur or The Phoenix Hotel's Vino Bar. Gembira Loka Zoo's latest dated news is from November 2025. Museum Affandi was left out because its October 2026 revitalisation notice could not be read. Sites that could not be read: borobudurpark.com, Museum Gunungapi Merapi, Melia Purosani and Hyatt Regency (HTTP 403), HeHa Sky View (suspended), Sumberwatu (no readable content). Many well-known warungs and cafés, including Kopi Klotok, Bale Raos and Mediterranea, have no official website and were not used.
